mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle WHERE fleet_id = #{fleetId}) AS vehicle_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role = 'DRIVER' AND fleet_id = #{fleetId}) AS driver_count

SELECT CASE WHEN ood = 1 THEN 'OOD' WHEN behavior_code IN ('c0','c1','c2','c3','c4','c5','c6','c7','c8','c9') THEN behavior_code ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS category, COUNT(*) AS frame_count FROM recognition_record
GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN record_type = 'SMS_ALERT' AND status IN ('OPEN','CONFIRMED') THEN 1 END) AS sms_alert_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN record_type = 'BACKLOG' AND status IN ('OPEN','CONFIRMED') THEN 1 END) AS backlog_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN record_type = 'SPEED_UNKNOWN' THEN 1 END) AS speed_unknown_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN record_type IN ('SMS_ALERT', 'BACKLOG') AND status = 'REVOKED' THEN 1 END) AS revoked_violation_count FROM alert_record
SELECT id, vehicle_id, captured_at, record_type, behavior_code, status FROM alert_record WHERE driver_id = #{driverId} ORDER BY captured_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT state_json FROM alert_vehicle_state WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId}
